game_concept: A speed quiz set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round, a new furs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the wires value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of furs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Keyword Switchboard' (Week 6 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Frozen Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Frozen Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 26 seconds.
